definitions.z_b: (perp - mu_s)/sigma_noise; mu_s = truncated-Gaussian perp centre of the full prepared 5-bit state s (prepared bit x 16 neighbour configs); sigma_noise = perp width of the prepared-|0> state with the same neighbours (H0: state-independent amplifier noise)
definitions.E3: mirror excess [N(z_b>3) - N(z_b<-3)]/N: one-sided off-axis excess beyond 3 sigma, needs only a symmetric core; 95% CI = +-1.96 sqrt(N+ + N-)/N
definitions.dseg: 2-D distance (noise sigma) of the window mean to the c0-c1 segment; H0 bound N*exp(-k^2/2)
definitions.frame: c0 = KDE mode of prepared-|0> state, c1 = fixed-width EM (c0 fixed, isotropic noise sigma, flat background), rotation = median per-config c0->c1 angle
